title: Temporal-Stability-Enhanced and Energy-Stable Dynamical Low-Rank Approximation for Multiscale Linear Kinetic Transport Equations
summary: In this paper, we develop an asymptotic-preserving dynamical low-rank method for the multiscale linear kinetic transport equation. The proposed scheme is unconditionally stable in the diffusive regime while preserving the correct asymptotic behavior, and can achieve significant reductions in computational cost through a low-rank representation and large time step stability. A low-rank formulation consistent with the discrete energy is introduced under the discrete ordinates discretization, and energy stability of the resulting scheme is established.
